title: Durable fulfillment recovery priority on the shared sync lane

acceptanceCriteria.description: The backend sync admission owner gives fulfillment-outbox work a canonical stately singleton, coalescing repeated cadence and recovery wake-ups without creating a second queue policy or provider execution path.

Busy fulfillment-outbox attempts durably enqueue a replacement through pg-boss, receive recovery priority, and fail closed when replacement admission cannot be proven; the deferral path never invokes the provider handler.

A long order sync cooperatively yields to due or recovering fulfillment work through the existing AbortSignal and persists its own replacement before acknowledging the yielded attempt, so the outbox receives a bounded shared-lane turn without overlapping database-heavy work.

Order, shipment, and fulfillment-outbox stately consumers share one session-advisory-lock leadership owner, preventing deploy-overlap consumers while retaining the existing shared database-heavy execution lane.
Lost-response and retry behavior still produces at most one external marketplace notification, and cancellation, retry, restart, concurrency, and stale-worker fencing remain provider-safe.
Strict TypeScript, production web build, the full 49-command source-of-truth guard pack, and focused sync compatibility guards pass at the exact reviewed SHA.

The change modifies queue control-plane code and offline guards only; it does not weaken shipped/cancelled protections, change schema, invoke providers, buy labels or postage, notify marketplaces, or mutate production orders or shipments.

sotBypass.details: All new decisions remain in backend queue admission and worker owners. The outbox provider handler, fulfillment receipt truth, order/shipment persistence, marketplace confirmation, label/postage behavior, and shipped/cancelled guards are unchanged; no frontend or adapter mints queue or provider truth.

evidence.proves: The canonical owner assigns fulfillment work one stately singleton and yields orders only for active, due, or bounded recovery-priority outbox rows, not arbitrary future cadence rows.

The mocked provider integration simulates an acknowledged marketplace confirmation followed by lost local settlement; retry reconciles durable provider truth and the notification spy remains at one call. No live provider or database is used.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-439-session-advisory-locks && npm run test:ps-426-awaiting-cursor-manual-sync
evidence.proves: Offline leadership and queued-worker tests retain one session-owned stately consumer leader, reject overlap across handoff, and keep execution separate from foreground admission without provider calls.

evidence.command: npm run test:sync-job-admission && npm run test:ps-359-shipment-sync-busy-defer && npm run test:ps-346-shipment-sync-worker-lanes
evidence.proves: Concurrent and ambiguous admission outcomes coalesce behind canonical singleton keys; busy deferral schedules through pg-boss, never executes the provider handler, and keeps all database-heavy sync work on one shared lane.
A busy outbox attempt cannot acknowledge success without a durable replacement ID, uses the stately recovery key and priority, and leaves provider execution untouched in the deferral path.

Injected long-running and non-cooperative work cannot falsely release the shared lane; cooperative order work yields after one bounded skip, durable replacement is required, and stale work remains fenced before recovery continues.
All 49 mandatory source-of-truth, durable-worker, lifecycle, provider-safety, billing, authorization, and shipped/cancelled safety command groups pass at the exact reviewed SHA.
Backend and frontend strict TypeScript checks pass.
The production frontend bundle builds successfully even though the implementation contains no frontend change.

The reviewed commit changes two backend queue-control owners and eight offline guards only. It changes no schema, migration, frontend, provider adapter, fulfillment handler, order/shipment table logic, label/postage path, or protected shipped/cancelled file.

migrations.rollbackPlan: No database migration is involved. If the rollout regresses worker availability, forward-revert the packet commit and reviewed implementation commit, redeploy the prior known-good revision 4ee244fa487d6d5bffd8cff09b06ba107c919ae2, and preserve all durable queue, provider-operation, order, shipment, inventory, and billing records.

Do not reset history, delete pg-boss rows, replay provider operations, or mutate shipped/cancelled production data. The previous runtime revision is 4ee244fa487d6d5bffd8cff09b06ba107c919ae2.

liveVerification.reason: Closure is based on deterministic offline queue-control, cancellation, leadership, and mocked-provider evidence at the exact reviewed SHA. No live provider action or production database mutation is necessary or safe for certification. Production deployment parity, read-only health endpoints, and worker logs are a separate post-push rollout gate and are not pre-claimed by this packet.
